intro.text: A peakspren bonded to the Iriali Stoneward Zu, who joins the diplomatic mission to the honorspren of Lasting Integrity.

items.text: Ua'pam bonded Zu around 1173, joining the fight because Odium was coming and he didn't want to run. Her new powers got her exiled from Iri, and he probably went with her to the Reshi Isles.

In 1175 Ua'pam and Zu joined the mission to Lasting Integrity, and in Shadesmar Zu saw his true form for the first time. He was glad to see his cousin Unativi, who captained their barge, though the two disagreed about how their people should face the Desolation.

Ua'pam scouted with Zu and helped find campsites on the journey, and discouraged her from confronting the Tukari caravan. When they reached Lasting Integrity, he presumably went back with Zu to bring word to Dalinar.

appearance.text: In Shadesmar, a tall, bald man of rock, like a mountain, with cracks in his skin that glow as if molten. He wears fur-lined clothing.

personality.text: Ua'pam says little, in a grinding voice, and sometimes rubs his knuckles together. Serious and cautious, he still prefers facing problems to running from them.
